segments.text: She is a classmate of Akira and is the chairperson of the committee.
She is a little bit rich, and she is always bothering Akira in some way.
Her grades are a little higher than Akira's, and her athletic ability is also a little higher than Akira's. She is a bit difficult to approach because of her strong-willed personality.
She has a beautiful but not pretty face, and is always moody. She has thick eyebrows and round eyes, and at first glance, she appears to be a selfish and bullying "ojousama" type.
From official site
Miki's childhood friend. He's always attached to her and seems to be treated like a servant by her.
He gets along well with Akira and become good friends. He is mild-mannered, shy, and quiet. His mannerisms are quite girly.
He wears short pants, glasses and shorts. He is shorter than Akira.
From official site
She is the daughter of the next-door neighbor of Akira and Naoko's older sister. She is Naoko's older sister, but they are just one year apart.

She has been married and left home by the time Akira can remember. Perhaps that is why she calls herself "auntie" to Akira. She is a former married woman who has recently left her husband and returned to her home, but the reason for this is a mystery.

She is a former married woman who left her husband and came back to Japan, but the reason is a mystery. She is a former married woman who left her husband and came back to Japan, but the reason for this is a mystery. However, like Naoko, she seems to think that Sho is still a child.

Unlike Naoko, she has a calm personality. She has a good looks, with long hair, big tits, and eyes that tickle a man's fancy. In addition, she can do everything from cooking to laundry. She is very caring, probably because she used to be a married woman.
From official site
She is the daughter of the next-door neighbor and a female college student.
She is asked to take care of the Akira and his friends but she just ends up causing a mess.
She is crass and masculine, and her words and actions are rough. She still treats Akira as a kid.
She is not good at housework and usually leaves it to her older sister, Kikuko. She has a bad drinking habit, and when she gets drunk, she gets unusually excited.
From official site
A homeroom teacher. During vacations, she does home visits for guidance purposes.
She is famous for being scary, she can be quite strict in class. In reality, she is a woman who loves shorties. This is the reason why she became a teacher.
Her love of shotas has grown so strong that she and her friends Chiharu and Kanako formed a Yaoi shota doujinshi circle, and have even participated at Comiket
Incidentally, the name of their circle is "Shonen Hosho Kyokai" ("Association for the Protection of Boys").
From official site
She is a professional manga artist.
She has been serializing a manga that is popular with older women who likes shota's. It is said to have a cult following.
She always wears a T-shirt and spats in her room, and always wears Japanese coat. She sometimes goes to the office in this outfit to submit manuscripts....
She draws yaoi style shota doujins with Mayumi and Chiharu.
From official site
A woman who works as an assistant to Kanako. She works as a freelancer as her day job.
She always wears only underwear in her room and goes out only 2 or 3 times a month. However, she seems to be the most sensible of the three in her doujin circle.
From official site
The protagonist of the story and Yumi's nephew. He refers to himself using "boku".
His father is working abroad and his mother is taking care of her father, so he is left in the care of Yumi and her daughter. He is an only child.
He is mild-mannered and shy and unware that he looks pretty. He does whatever the girls tell him to do resulting in the creation of a "secret game"
While shy he is not an introvert. He is intelligent, likes games and has friends. He's not particularly good at sports.
He's interested in the opposite sex but too shy to do anything about it. His embarrassment and single track mind regarding sex is found to be cute and is enough to attract girls.
From official site
Yumi's only daughter. She is a cousin to Akira. Her father passed away shortly after she was born and has lived alone with her mother ever since. She is strong and very affectionate.

She has a strong personality and is not very sociable. When he speaks with Kazuko and others, she usually does not speak aggressively, but only replies with a simple "ah-ha". Of course, she treats Akira in the same way. In a sense, she is a shy girl like Akira.

Like a girl of her age, she is interested in sex and the opposite sex (especially Akira), but she is reluctant to move forward on her own. Most of the time, she is encouraged by Kazuko. She complains but goes along with Kazuko's actions, and it seems to show it.
She likes Akira, however, she can't be honest with herself due to her personality so she sometimes speaks to him in a spiteful manner. She is jealous of Kazuko who is open and frank with Akira.
From official site

He is a boy who lives up to his nickname of "one-punch boy. He likes to go out and about, which is probably why he is so tanned when he takes off his clothes. He is a bit childish, but he also hangs out with Kazuko and the girls in Yuki's group.

His personality is cheerful and a bit short-tempered. He is the type of good-natured kid you would expect to find at least one in your class. He has a funny way of talking and acting, and Kazuko plays with him.
He is not that popular with girls. He has a tendency to be easily infatuated. He is very knowledgeable about sex for some reason. Kazuko think of him as "stupid and lecherous"
From official site
She is Narumi's younger sister. She is friends with Akira and Junpei's girlfriend. According to others she is "stupid and lecherous".

Kazuko is a cheerful and open-minded girl who can get along with anyone. However, it is said that she does not get along well with her older sister Narumi. She is characterized by her glasses and braided hair.

She looks like a quiet girl with glasses, but in fact, she is a leader among the four because of her curiosity and aggressiveness. Even her boyfriend, Junpei is completely under her control. She is a very active person, and is very active with the opposite sex which she inherited from her older sister.
She is one to speak her mind and makes her feelings and words known. She helps her friends when they are unable to express themselves out loud. She likes what she likes because she's straightforward.
